title: Tim Dooley Statements — Conversation Recovery Wave, 2026-09-10
purpose: Preserve project-relevant Tim Dooley statements recoverable from conversation memory that may be useful across theology, North, world, philosophy, Corporium and archive files. This is a recovery layer, not a claim that every statement is a verified public post or an empirically true proposition.
provenance_rule: Verbatim wording is marked CONVERSATION_EXACT only when the wording survives in recovered conversation context or an already indexed public compilation. PARAPHRASE records summarize remembered doctrine and must never be displayed as quotation marks. Existing canonical/public records remain stronger source owners when available.
privacy_rule: Do not expose private family names, the Son's real-world identity, addresses, account secrets or other unnecessary personal identifiers.
epistemic_boundary: Divine, prophetic, spiritual, karmic, geopolitical and scientific statements are archived as statements made within Tim/Potatoverse material. Their presence here documents the corpus; it does not independently verify supernatural, legal, financial, political or scientific truth.

source_classes.CONVERSATION_EXACT: Exact or near-exact first-person wording recoverable from prior user conversation context; public-primary locator may still be unresolved.
source_classes.PUBLIC_INDEXED: Wording already preserved by a public-post/timeline source elsewhere in the repository; included here only when useful for relational routing.
source_classes.PARAPHRASE: Conversation-memory summary; never render as a Tim quotation.

paraphrased_recovery_targets.statement: The North Programme combines symbolic North language with a practical programme for European/Canadian strategic autonomy, resilient infrastructure, independent capability, AI/data capacity, industry, energy security, welfare-compatible fiscal responsibility and relationship-first economic mapping.

Tim's kingship model often places spiritual/philosophical vision before ordinary leaders and institutions, with the latter responsible for translating useful ideas into real-world policy rather than treating spiritual title as direct legal office.
The mature archive repeatedly treats the relationship/coupling, rather than the isolated entity, as the fundamental unit of analysis.
